dedupe_keys.name: application of traffic load balancing algorithm case of vigo

description: The documented Vigo application combines Bluetooth speed/volume observations, fifteen-minute LSTM traffic forecasts and dynamic route balancing in PTV Vissim. Twenty traffic scenarios report speed improvement up to three percent, eight-percent less delay and ten-percent less standstill time during peak weekday hours. Reported pollutant reductions are four to eleven percent. These are modelled scenario outcomes, not a city-wide measured intervention. The prediction model and full route-balancing application have different roles. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
name: Application of Traffic Load-Balancing Algorithm—Case of Vigo
notes: Native publication date is not a verified observation interval. Project membership alone does not establish resource inclusion. Listed unverified routes timed out in zero-body landing checks; exact native metadata was retrieved successfully. Underlying files remain unchecked.
